name: Novotel Suites Yogyakarta Malioboro
short_description: A 147-suite hotel directly on Malioboro Street, Yogyakarta's main pedestrian shopping boulevard, with an eco-certification and a rooftop pool bar.
ai_summary: Novotel Suites Yogyakarta Malioboro sits directly on Malioboro Street -- car-free for pedestrians from 5-10pm -- close to Malioboro Mall and Tugu Railway Station. The 147 smart-concept suites are eco-certified, and the hotel's official ALL page shows a 4.7/5 customer rating from 1,359 reviews as of the research date, among the highest review volumes of any Accor property in Yogyakarta. Guests praise the rooftop pool bar and central location, while some reviews mention dated rooms and occasional maintenance issues such as lift malfunctions.

core_facts.address: Jl. Perwakilan No. 1, Suryatmajan, Danurejan, 55213 Yogyakarta, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Directly on Malioboro Street, Yogyakarta's main pedestrian shopping boulevard
147 smart-concept suites, ideal for both business trips and longer leisure stays

4.7/5 customer review rating from 1,359 reviews on the official ALL booking page -- one of the highest review counts of any Accor hotel in the city

research_highlights: 1,359 reviews at a 4.7/5 average makes this one of the most-reviewed Accor hotels in Yogyakarta

faqs.question: Is Novotel Suites Yogyakarta Malioboro directly on Malioboro Street?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's located on Malioboro Street itself, close to Malioboro Mall and Tugu Railway Station, with the street becoming car-free for pedestrians from 5-10pm.

faqs.question: How many rooms does Novotel Suites Yogyakarta Malioboro have?
faqs.answer: 147 smart-concept suites, geared toward both short business stays and longer leisure trips.
